summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K on 28 August 2026 announcing the issuance of CNY2.5 billion 1.950% fixed-rate senior unsecured notes due 2030 and CNY1.5 billion 2.300% notes due 2034, totaling CNY4 billion under its Debt Issuance Programme. The notes were listed on the FCA Official List and admitted to trading on the London Stock Exchange Main Market. This is a routine debt issuance and listing notification, not a special situation, as it involves ordinary financing activity with no equity, control, or restructuring implications.
